title: SB27 (2026 Regular): Regulated Firearms - Seven-Day Waiting Period - Exceptions

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2026RS/bills/sb/sb0027f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader: the bill as filed (2026 session). Bracketed [A] before 'licensee' / 'person' is deleted from existing law and left out of the quotes. No passage vote in the record; later amendments, if any, are not in the text read.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-123): (1) SUBJECT TO PARAGRAPH (2) OF THIS SUBSECTION, A licensee may not sell, rent, or transfer a regulated firearm until after 7 days following the time a firearm application is executed by the firearm applicant, in triplicate, and the original is forwarded by the prospective seller or transferor to the Secretary.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-123): (2) THE REQUIREMENT UNDER PARAGRAPH (1) OF THIS SUBSECTION THAT THE SALE, RENTAL, OR TRANSFER OF A REGULATED FIREARM MAY NOT OCCUR UNTIL AFTER 7 DAYS FOLLOWING THE TIME AN APPLICATION IS EXECUTED DOES NOT APPLY TO A SALE, RENTAL, OR TRANSFER OF A REGULATED FIREARM IF THE INDIVIDUAL WHO PURCHASES, RENTS, OR RECEIVES THE REGULATED FIREARM IS: (I) A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER; (II) AN INDIVIDUAL WHO HAS RETIRED AS A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER IN GOOD STANDING FROM A LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCY; OR (III) AN INDIVIDUAL TO WHOM A PERMIT TO WEAR, CARRY, OR TRANSPORT A HANDGUN HAS BEEN ISSUED UNDER TITLE 5, SUBTITLE 3 OF THIS ARTICLE.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-124): (1) (I) SUBJECT TO SUBPARAGRAPH (II) OF THIS PARAGRAPH, A person who is not a licensee may not sell, rent, transfer, or purchase a regulated firearm until after 7 days following the time a firearm application is executed by the firearm applicant, in triplicate, and the original is forwarded by a licensee to the Secretary.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-124): (II) THE REQUIREMENT UNDER SUBPARAGRAPH (I) OF THIS PARAGRAPH THAT A PERSON MAY NOT SELL, RENT, TRANSFER, OR PURCHASE A REGULATED FIREARM UNTIL 7 DAYS AFTER AN APPLICATION IS EXECUTED DOES NOT APPLY TO A SALE, RENTAL, OR TRANSFER OF A REGULATED FIREARM IF THE INDIVIDUAL WHO PURCHASES, RENTS, OR RECEIVES THE REGULATED FIREARM IS: 1. A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER; 2. AN INDIVIDUAL WHO HAS RETIRED AS A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER IN GOOD STANDING FROM A LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCY; OR 3. AN INDIVIDUAL TO WHOM A PERMIT TO WEAR, CARRY, OR TRANSPORT A HANDGUN HAS BEEN ISSUED UNDER TITLE 5, SUBTITLE 3 OF THIS ARTICLE.
